name: U.S. city average CPI-U, all items, not seasonally adjusted
note: Calendar-year CPI is an approximate comparison with city fiscal-year spending. The 2025 published average excludes October, when CPI collection was unavailable. No full-year 2026 or 2027 CPI is used. CPI measures consumer prices, not the specific costs of city services; this benchmark does not adjust for population, staffing, service changes or one-time projects.
